frequency_question: How often do proposed financial service tax clarifications reach formal council approval within 49 days of initial visible signals?
membership_rule: Includes all formal agenda items concerning financial/banking service tax rates discussed by the federal indirect tax council where prior committee referral occurred. Excludes general annual budget rate changes.

cases.name: Co-lending sub-vention fee GST exemption review
Payment aggregator merchant discount rate tax clarification

coverage_note: 5 major financial service tax clarification items named; representative of the class of targeted administrative clarifications.
known_gaps: Minor state-level referral items not tracked in national financial dailies are excluded.
skeleton: Total financial service clarification items on council agendas over 5 years, categorized by whether advance committee signals preceded rapid approval.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 observed historical agenda items = 80% baseline conditional frequency given advance signals.
validity_reason: Tax council procedural rules and consensus-seeking mechanisms change slowly over multi-year periods.
